notes.title: Mercenaries of the Kingdom!
notes.content:
Hello challengers!
If you have played Cursor Challenge, you will most likely like [b]hard, hell bullet and roguelike[/b] games.
My new game, [b]Mercenaries of the Kingdom[/b], does just that.
Command a group of mercenaries and make your way through thousands of enemies who only want your destruction!

Add it to your [b]wishlist[/b], so you don't miss the moment when the first DEMO comes out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23029796/63e4717b30b05a1d42f19fc8d22e86924d5f8cba.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update for Cursor Challenge!!!
notes.content:
Hello dear Challengers!

I hadn't gotten my hands on this title for many, many years, so I decided to try to update its [b]engine[/b] or bring it to the version of Unity that I use for the most recent games.

Now, Cursors Challenge should run faster and have fewer compatibility problems with more modern PCs.

However, because six years have passed since its release, there may be some bugs due to the update and the compatibility of the code with the new version.
In that case, contact me on the Community Hub, and I will try to fix the problem.

Finishing the last mission of the last mode is almost impossible, as you know by now, so good luck to all of you brave enough to try it!


I'm updating all my games, both new and older, so please check them out:
[b]Cursor Challenge
Home Wars
Multicellular
Bugs!
Age of Undead
Gummy Dummy Battles[/b]

notes.title: Hi Challengers!
notes.content:
Hi Challengers, how are you?

We write this announce to say that Insane Dreamers isn't dead!

Actually we are working to develop a new game, totally different from Cursor Challenge, a indie multi-genre, much much more complex.

Naturally we are ready to help you if there are problems with Cursor.

The release of our new game will be in the first months of 2017.

Cursor Challenge was our first game, it was a try to test how Steam works.
Now we begin to have fun!

Thanks for your attention.
Bye!

notes.title: Update of Cursor Challenge
notes.content:
Hi Challengers!


Here the new update of the game:

- some bugs fixed

- 9 new soundtracks

- Trading Cards


REMEMBER that NOBODY has broken our last levels!

We challenge everybody to break it!



In the next update probably we add the Achievement.

For every problems, curiosity or advice contact us.


Good luck again Challengers!!!

notes.title: For the Challengers!!!
notes.content:
Hi Challengers!

I started to work about Trading Cards, as some of you have asked, I think we still have to wait a few days.

After that probably I’ll add the achievements too.

Furthermore if someone find some levels unbalanced in the modes, please contact me and report me its name, thanks.

And now the “Update of the Challange”:
NO ONE HAS YET BROKEN THE LAST LEVEL!
In these days I have read about many people who say that reach the end of the game should not be so difficult as i announced, but for now we haven’t winners!
So, come on, show me that I'm wrong to say that the last level is impossible! Does nobody want to see his/hers name on the Wall of Fame?

I’m waiting you!

Good luck Challengers!
